title: Newton-Raphson implied volatility, single option
frame: DIKETAHUI: market price V, S, K, T, r, q, type. DITANYAKAN: sigma_imp (decimal). RUMUS: card Core 1: sigma_{n+1}=sigma_n-(BS(sigma_n)-V)/vega(sigma_n), vega=S~ n(d1) sqrt T; start 0.2..0.3 or Manaster-Koehler; fallback brentq on [1e-6, 5] if vega<1e-8 or step leaves bounds; toolkit implied_vol. JAWAB: 1) check V within (intrinsic, S~). 2) iterate to |BS-V|<1e-8. 3) fallback if needed. 4) reprice check. 5) write.
formulas: vega = S e^{-qT} n(d1) sqrt T
pitfalls: deep OTM short-dated: vega ~ 0, Newton diverges

title: Brent/bisection implied vol per row with NaN outside bounds
deliverables: per row [M]: iv (NaN if no solution); summary: n_nan
frame: DIKETAHUI: [M] quotes with price, S, K, T, r, q, type. DITANYAKAN: IV per row, NaN where price outside no-arbitrage range. RUMUS: card Core 1 / V5(b): brentq on f(sigma)=BS(sigma)-V over [1e-6, 5]; bounds C in (max(0,S~-K~), S~), P in (max(0,K~-S~), K~); toolkit implied_vol(lo, hi). JAWAB: 1) T in years. 2) bound mask. 3) solve masked rows. 4) NaN and count others. 5) reprice check. 6) write.
formulas: S~ = S e^{-qT}, K~ = K e^{-rT}

title: Vectorised Newton IV with all-points convergence
frame: DIKETAHUI: arrays [M] of prices and inputs, tol, max_iter. DITANYAKAN: IV array and iteration count. RUMUS: card pitfall: iterate the whole vector until max|step|<tol (all()), not per-point exit; clip sigma to (1e-6, 5). JAWAB: 1) sigma0 vector. 2) loop: price, vega, step [M]. 3) stop when all |step|<tol. 4) report iterations. 5) write.

title: Manaster-Koehler starting value
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, price. DITANYAKAN: Newton seed and resulting IV. RUMUS: card Core 1: sigma0 = sqrt(2|ln(F/K)|/T) with F=S e^{(r-q)T} (inflection point; Newton converges monotonically). JAWAB: 1) F. 2) sigma0 (floor 0.1 when F~K). 3) Newton. 4) write.

title: Brenner-Subrahmanyam ATM approximation
frame: DIKETAHUI: call price C, S, K, T, r, q. DITANYAKAN: BS approximation and error vs exact. RUMUS: card Core 2: sigma = sqrt(2pi/T) C/S~ (exact-ish at K~=S~). JAWAB: 1) S~. 2) approx. 3) exact by implied_vol. 4) error; larger away from ATM-forward (expected bias, not a bug). 5) write.
pitfalls: applied at K = S0 with r != q carries a real bias

title: Corrado-Miller approximation
frame: DIKETAHUI: C, S, K, T, r, q. DITANYAKAN: Corrado-Miller IV. RUMUS: card Core 3: x=sqrt(2pi)/(S~+K~)[C-(S~-K~)/2+sqrt((C-(S~-K~)/2)^2-(S~-K~)^2/pi)]; sigma=x/sqrt T; floor discriminant at 0. JAWAB: 1) S~, K~ (discounted, V4(a)). 2) disc, floor. 3) x, sigma. 4) error vs implied_vol. 5) write.
pitfalls: raw S, K instead of discounted unless the task writes raw

title: Hallerbach approximation
frame: DIKETAHUI: C, S, K, T, r, q. DITANYAKAN: Hallerbach IV. RUMUS: card Core 3: x=sqrt(2pi)/(2(S~+K~))[2C+K~-S~+sqrt((2C+K~-S~)^2-1.85(S~+K~)(K~-S~)^2/(pi sqrt(K~ S~)))]; floor discriminant at 0; sigma=x/sqrt T. JAWAB: 1) S~, K~. 2) disc. 3) sigma. 4) error. 5) write.

title: Li ATM cubic approximation
deliverables: per row [M]: iv_li_atm, error; NaN count
frame: DIKETAHUI: C, S, K, T, r, q. DITANYAKAN: Li ATM IV. RUMUS: card Core 4: alpha=sqrt(2pi)C/S~; z=cos(arccos(3alpha/sqrt32)/3); x=2sqrt2 z - sqrt(8z^2-6alpha/(sqrt2 z)); NaN if |3alpha/sqrt32|>1. JAWAB: 1) alpha. 2) domain check. 3) x, sigma=x/sqrt T. 4) error vs exact. 5) write.
formulas: x = 2 sqrt2 z - sqrt(8z^2 - 6 alpha/(sqrt2 z))

title: Li non-ATM rational approximation
frame: DIKETAHUI: C, S, K, T, r, q. DITANYAKAN: Li IV away from ATM. RUMUS: card Core 4: eta=K~/S~, c=C/S~, alpha=sqrt(2pi)(2c+eta-1)/(1+eta), rho=|eta-1|/c^2; rho<=1.4 -> ATM cubic with this alpha; rho>1.4 -> x=[alpha+sqrt(alpha^2-4(eta-1)^2/(1+eta))]/2. If the task spells a formula, follow it. JAWAB: 1) eta, c, alpha, rho. 2) branch. 3) sigma. 4) error. 5) write.

title: Approximation accuracy comparison table
deliverables: per row [M]: exact, bs, cm, hallerbach, li, errors; summary mean abs error
frame: DIKETAHUI: chain [M] of call prices and inputs. DITANYAKAN: each approximation, error vs Newton/Brent, summary stats. RUMUS: card Core 1-4; implied_vol for exact. JAWAB: 1) exact IV. 2) each approximation. 3) errors in vol points. 4) summary by method (mean, max abs). 5) check errors grow away from ATM and at high x. 6) write.

title: IV from bid and ask separately
deliverables: per row [M]: iv_bid, iv_mid, iv_ask, spread_vol
frame: DIKETAHUI: quotes with bid, ask; inputs. DITANYAKAN: IV at bid, mid, ask and spread. RUMUS: card V1(b): invert each price with implied_vol; NaN if bid below intrinsic. JAWAB: 1) clean quotes. 2) mid=(bid+ask)/2. 3) three inversions. 4) spread=iv_ask-iv_bid. 5) check iv_bid<=iv_mid<=iv_ask. 6) write.

title: Black-76 implied volatility on an implied forward
frame: DIKETAHUI: option prices per expiry, F (given or implied from parity), DF. DITANYAKAN: Black-76 IV. RUMUS: card V3(b): invert C=DF[F N(d1)-K N(d2)] (black76_price) by Brent. JAWAB: 1) F, DF per expiry. 2) per row Brent on black76_price. 3) reprice check. 4) write.

title: Call and put IV equality check under parity
frame: DIKETAHUI: paired call/put quotes. DITANYAKAN: IV of each and difference. RUMUS: card invariant: if parity holds with the used S, r, q, iv_call = iv_put; a gap signals wrong q/borrow or forward. JAWAB: 1) pair. 2) IVs. 3) diff. 4) optional: implied q that equalises. 5) write.
formulas: C - P = S~ - K~ => iv_C = iv_P

title: Put-call parity check and violations
deliverables: per pair [P]: lhs, rhs, residual, violation flag; summary count
frame: DIKETAHUI: call and put mids per (expiry, strike), S, r, q. DITANYAKAN: parity residuals and violation count. RUMUS: card Core 5: C - P = S e^{-qT} - K e^{-rT}; residual = (C-P) - rhs; violation if |residual| > threshold (strict). JAWAB: 1) clean, pair. 2) T. 3) rhs. 4) residuals. 5) flags, counts. 6) write.
formulas: C - P = S e^{-qT} - K e^{-rT} = DF (F - K)

title: Synthetic forward from mid quotes
deliverables: per pair [P]: F_mid; per expiry [E]: median F
frame: DIKETAHUI: call and put mids, DF (or r). DITANYAKAN: synthetic forward per strike and expiry summary. RUMUS: card Core 5: F = K + (C - P)/DF. JAWAB: 1) pair. 2) F per pair. 3) per expiry aggregate (median or ATM pair) as asked. 4) check stable across K. 5) write.
pitfalls: multiplying by DF instead of dividing

title: Executable forward bid/ask and violation vs theory
deliverables: per pair [P]: F_bid, F_ask, F_th, violation
frame: DIKETAHUI: bid/ask for calls and puts, DF, theory forward F_th (S e^{(r-q)T}). DITANYAKAN: executable forward band and violation amount. RUMUS: card Core 6: F_bid=K+(C_bid-P_ask)/DF, F_ask=K+(C_ask-P_bid)/DF; violation=max(F_bid-F_th, F_th-F_ask, 0). JAWAB: 1) clean, pair. 2) band. 3) F_th. 4) violation. 5) check F_bid<=F_ask. 6) write.
pitfalls: swapping legs: bid bound uses call BID and put ASK

title: DF and forward by regression across strikes per expiry
deliverables: per expiry [E]: DF, F, r_implied, n_strikes
frame: DIKETAHUI: clean paired mids per expiry. DITANYAKAN: DF and F per expiry. RUMUS: card Core 8: regress (C_mid-P_mid) on K: slope=-DF, intercept=DF F; r=-ln(DF)/T. JAWAB: 1) group by expiry. 2) OLS (need >=2 strikes). 3) DF, F. 4) implied r. 5) residual std. 6) write.

title: Implied dividend yield per expiry
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, r (or DF), forward per expiry. DITANYAKAN: implied q per expiry. RUMUS: card Core 7: q = r - ln(F/S)/T. JAWAB: 1) F per expiry (synthetic or regression). 2) q. 3) term structure table sorted by expiry. 4) write.

title: Implied borrow cost
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, r, known dividend yield q, synthetic forward F. DITANYAKAN: implied borrow cost. RUMUS: card Core 7: F = S exp((r-q-b)T) -> b = r - q - ln(F/S)/T. JAWAB: 1) F. 2) b. 3) sign check: borrow lowers F like a dividend. 4) write.

title: Implied interest rate from discount factor
frame: DIKETAHUI: DF per expiry (regression or given forward). DITANYAKAN: implied continuous rate. RUMUS: card Core 7: r = -ln(DF)/T; DF=(C-P)/(F-K) when F known. JAWAB: 1) DF. 2) r. 3) write.

title: Quote cleaning: one-sided, crossed, stale with precedence
deliverables: summary: one_sided_count, crossed_count, stale_count, clean_count, total
frame: DIKETAHUI: chain [M] with bid, ask, timestamp; snapshot time, max_age. DITANYAKAN: exclusion counts and clean mask. RUMUS: card conventions: one_sided (bid<=0 or ask<=0 or NaN) -> crossed (bid>=ask, or > per rule) -> stale (age>max_age strict); masks applied with & ~earlier. JAWAB: 1) parse times. 2) one_sided mask. 3) crossed & ~one_sided. 4) stale & ~(prior). 5) clean. 6) check sum counts = total. 7) write.
pitfalls: counting a row in two buckets when the task says each row once

title: Pairing calls and puts among clean quotes
frame: DIKETAHUI: clean quotes with (expiry, strike, type). DITANYAKAN: matched pairs and missing count. RUMUS: card: pair only among CLEAN on (expiry, strike); missing = keys present on exactly one side. JAWAB: 1) split calls, puts. 2) inner merge. 3) symmetric difference count. 4) sort expiry then numeric strike. 5) write.

title: Time to expiry from exact timestamps ACT/365
deliverables: per row [M]: T_years; output keeps iso string
frame: DIKETAHUI: snapshot timestamp, expiry timestamps (ISO, UTC). DITANYAKAN: T in years. RUMUS: card V2(a): T = seconds/(365 x 86400). JAWAB: 1) parse as UTC. 2) seconds diff. 3) T. 4) keep original ISO with Z for output. 5) drop/flag T<=0. 6) write.
pitfalls: 365.25 or date-only differences for intraday expiries

title: Inverse (coin-margined) option premium conversion and IV
frame: DIKETAHUI: quotes in coin units, reference price (underlying/futures/index per the task), strikes in USD, r. DITANYAKAN: USD premium and IV. RUMUS: card Core 9: premium_usd = premium_coin x reference; invert BS/Black-76 on USD premium. JAWAB: 1) reference per row. 2) convert bid, ask, mid. 3) IV (black76_price with F=futures if given). 4) write vol as decimal.
pitfalls: applying USD parity to raw coin premiums

title: Put-call parity in coin units for inverse options
frame: DIKETAHUI: coin premiums, F_ref, K, DF, F. DITANYAKAN: parity residual in coin. RUMUS: card Core 9: C_c - P_c = DF (F - K)/F_ref; or convert to USD and use C_usd - P_usd = DF (F - K). JAWAB: 1) pair. 2) rhs in coin. 3) residual. 4) write.

title: Forward audit table and violations subset
deliverables: audit [P]: expiry, strike, F_bid, F_ask, F_th, violation; violations [V] subset
frame: DIKETAHUI: clean pairs, DF, F_th per expiry, threshold. DITANYAKAN: audit per (expiry, strike) and violations table. RUMUS: card Core 6; violations = audit rows with violation > threshold (strict). JAWAB: 1) audit rows. 2) violation amounts. 3) filter. 4) sort. 5) check violations subset of audit. 6) write both.

title: ATM implied vol by interpolation in strike
deliverables: per expiry [E]: F, K_lo, K_hi, atm_iv
frame: DIKETAHUI: IV per strike per expiry, F per expiry. DITANYAKAN: ATM IV at K=F. RUMUS: card: linear in strike between K_lo<F<=K_hi (unless total variance or log-moneyness stated). JAWAB: 1) sort strikes. 2) find bracket. 3) interpolate. 4) NaN if F outside range. 5) write.

title: ATM vol term structure via total variance
deliverables: table [E]: T, atm_iv, total_var; interpolated vol at target T
frame: DIKETAHUI: ATM IV per expiry [E], target maturity. DITANYAKAN: interpolated ATM vol and forward vols. RUMUS: w=sigma^2 T linear in T; sigma(T*)=sqrt(w(T*)/T*); forward vol between T1,T2 = sqrt((w2-w1)/(T2-T1)). JAWAB: 1) w per expiry. 2) interpolate. 3) forward vols; NaN if w decreasing. 4) write.

title: Volatility smile and skew per expiry
deliverables: per expiry [E]: atm_iv, skew metric; per row iv
frame: DIKETAHUI: chain IVs per strike and expiry. DITANYAKAN: smile table and skew. RUMUS: use OTM side (puts K<F, calls K>=F); skew = iv(K1) - iv(K2) at stated moneyness, or 25-delta risk reversal iv_c25 - iv_p25 (delta from bs_greeks). JAWAB: 1) IVs. 2) choose OTM leg. 3) skew metric. 4) write.

title: Prices below intrinsic: no IV, count
deliverables: per row [M]: iv or NaN, reason; summary counts
frame: DIKETAHUI: prices and inputs. DITANYAKAN: IV with flags for prices outside (max(0, S~-K~), S~). RUMUS: card conventions: no IV below discounted intrinsic or above S~ (call) / K~ (put). JAWAB: 1) bounds. 2) reason labels. 3) IV only for valid. 4) counts. 5) write.
formulas: C < max(0, S~ - K~) => no IV

title: Parity with discrete dividends: implied PV of dividends
frame: DIKETAHUI: call and put mids, S, r, K, T. DITANYAKAN: implied PV of dividends. RUMUS: C - P = S - PV(D) - K e^{-rT} -> PV(D) = S - K e^{-rT} - (C - P). JAWAB: 1) pairs. 2) PV per pair. 3) aggregate per expiry. 4) write.

title: Conversion and reversal arbitrage with bid-ask
frame: DIKETAHUI: call/put bid-ask, stock bid-ask, K, T, r, q. DITANYAKAN: arbitrage P&L. RUMUS: conversion (buy stock at ask, buy put at ask, sell call at bid): PV PnL = C_bid - P_ask - S_ask e^{-qT} + K e^{-rT} (cash dividends: - S_ask + PV(D)); reversal (short stock at bid, sell put at bid, buy call at ask): S_bid e^{-qT} - K e^{-rT} - C_ask + P_bid (less borrow cost). JAWAB: 1) PV of K. 2) both PnLs. 3) flag > 0. 4) write.
formulas: conv = C_bid - P_ask - S_ask e^{-qT} + K e^{-rT}
rev = S_bid e^{-qT} - K e^{-rT} - C_ask + P_bid

title: Box spread implied rate
deliverables: per strike pair: box_price, DF, r_implied
frame: DIKETAHUI: calls and puts at K1<K2, same expiry. DITANYAKAN: box value and implied rate. RUMUS: box = (C1 - C2) - (P1 - P2) = DF (K2 - K1); r=-ln(DF)/T. JAWAB: 1) mids (or executable sides). 2) box. 3) DF. 4) r. 5) write.

title: American parity inequality check on listed quotes
deliverables: per pair [P]: C - P, lower, upper, violation
frame: DIKETAHUI: American call/put quotes, S, K, r, q, T. DITANYAKAN: bound violations. RUMUS: S e^{-qT} - K <= C - P <= S - K e^{-rT}. JAWAB: 1) pair. 2) bounds. 3) flags/amounts. 4) write.
formulas: S e^{-qT} - K <= C - P <= S - K e^{-rT}

title: IV solver tolerance and repricing check
deliverables: per row [M]: iv, price_error; summary max_abs_error
frame: DIKETAHUI: IVs and inputs. DITANYAKAN: max repricing error. RUMUS: card: BS(sigma_imp) reprices within 1e-8; vol error ~ price error / vega. JAWAB: 1) bs_price(iv). 2) error. 3) max. 4) flag rows over tol. 5) write.

title: IV with annually compounded rate input
frame: DIKETAHUI: prices, r with annual compounding. DITANYAKAN: IV with correct discounting. RUMUS: r_c = ln(1+r); then implied_vol with r_c. JAWAB: 1) convert. 2) invert. 3) write.

title: Missing rate from a given forward
frame: DIKETAHUI: C, P at K, forward F, T. DITANYAKAN: DF and r. RUMUS: card completion: DF = (C - P)/(F - K); r = -ln(DF)/T (avoid K ~ F). JAWAB: 1) choose pair with |F-K| not small. 2) DF. 3) r. 4) write.

title: Missing forward from ATM pair
frame: DIKETAHUI: pairs per expiry, DF. DITANYAKAN: forward. RUMUS: card: choose strike with smallest |C - P|; F = K + (C - P)/DF. JAWAB: 1) |C-P| per pair. 2) argmin. 3) F. 4) write.

title: Price from IV and completing a missing put by parity
deliverables: per row [M]: price filled, source flag
frame: DIKETAHUI: some calls with IV, some puts missing. DITANYAKAN: filled prices. RUMUS: bs_price(sigma) for missing price; P = C - S e^{-qT} + K e^{-rT}. JAWAB: 1) identify missing. 2) fill by parity (or BS with given IV). 3) flag source. 4) write.
formulas: P = C - S e^{-qT} + K e^{-rT}

title: Implied volatility surface grid
frame: DIKETAHUI: chain IVs. DITANYAKAN: surface as pivot (rows expiry, columns strike). RUMUS: implied_vol per row; pivot with NaN for missing. JAWAB: 1) IVs. 2) sort. 3) pivot. 4) write in requested orientation.

title: Calendar arbitrage check on total variance
frame: DIKETAHUI: IV at fixed log-moneyness across expiries. DITANYAKAN: calendar violations. RUMUS: w(k,T)=sigma^2 T must be non-decreasing in T at fixed k=ln(K/F). JAWAB: 1) w. 2) diffs over T. 3) flag negative. 4) write.
formulas: w(k, T2) >= w(k, T1) for T2 > T1

title: Butterfly convexity and strike monotonicity checks
deliverables: per strike triple: butterfly value, flags
frame: DIKETAHUI: call prices across strikes [K] one expiry. DITANYAKAN: static arbitrage flags. RUMUS: monotone: C(K1) >= C(K2) for K1<K2; slope bound -DF <= (C2-C1)/(K2-K1) <= 0; convex: butterfly C1 - 2C2 + C3 >= 0 (equal spacing; else weighted). JAWAB: 1) sort. 2) spreads. 3) butterflies. 4) flags. 5) write.

title: Garman-Kohlhagen implied volatility for FX options
frame: DIKETAHUI: FX option premiums, spot, K, T, r_d, r_f. DITANYAKAN: IV. RUMUS: implied_vol(price, S, K, T, r=r_d, q=r_f) (GK = BS with q=r_f). JAWAB: 1) premium units (domestic per foreign). 2) invert. 3) write.
pitfalls: premium quoted in % of notional or foreign units: convert first

title: Robust IV for deep OTM short-dated options
frame: DIKETAHUI: deep OTM quotes, small T. DITANYAKAN: IV robustly. RUMUS: card pitfall: Newton diverges when vega ~ 0; use brentq on [1e-6, 5] or log-price objective ln BS(sigma) - ln V; Jaeckel (2015) for machine precision. JAWAB: 1) detect small vega. 2) bracket solver. 3) record method. 4) write.

title: IV from ATM straddle price
frame: DIKETAHUI: straddle price Str = C + P at K ~ F, S, T, r, q. DITANYAKAN: IV and implied move. RUMUS: ATM-forward: Str ~ 2 S~ sigma sqrt(T/(2pi)) -> sigma ~ sqrt(2pi/T) Str/(2S~); exact by solving BS_C + BS_P = Str. JAWAB: 1) approx. 2) exact Brent. 3) expected move ~ Str/DF. 4) write.

title: Stale quote detection by age
deliverables: per row [M]: age_seconds, stale flag; count
frame: DIKETAHUI: quote timestamps, snapshot time, max_age (seconds). DITANYAKAN: stale flags. RUMUS: card: age = snapshot - quote_time; stale if age > max_age (strict unless >= written); apply after one_sided and crossed. JAWAB: 1) parse UTC. 2) age. 3) flag & ~earlier. 4) count. 5) write.

title: Relative bid-ask spread and vol spread per row
frame: DIKETAHUI: clean quotes with bid, ask, vega or IVs. DITANYAKAN: spreads. RUMUS: spread = ask - bid; rel = spread/mid; vol spread ~ spread/vega or iv_ask - iv_bid. JAWAB: 1) clean. 2) compute. 3) summary by expiry. 4) write.

title: Locked vs crossed quote rule
deliverables: counts: locked, crossed under stated rule
frame: DIKETAHUI: quotes, rule text (> or >=). DITANYAKAN: crossed count. RUMUS: card: crossed = bid > ask; locked (bid = ask) counts as crossed only if rule says >=. JAWAB: 1) parse rule. 2) mask with np.isclose for equality. 3) exclude one-sided first. 4) count. 5) write.

title: Chain summary json with per-expiry forwards
deliverables: summary json: totals, exclusions; per expiry [E]: F, DF, q
frame: DIKETAHUI: full chain [M], S, r. DITANYAKAN: summary counts and per-expiry table. RUMUS: card worked frame: clean -> pair -> regression (Core 8) -> q (Core 7). JAWAB: 1) T. 2) cleaning counts. 3) pairs. 4) F, DF per expiry. 5) implied q. 6) cast numpy ints, round floats; write.
pitfalls: numpy ints in JSON: cast to int

title: Bootstrap discrete dividend between expiries from forwards
frame: DIKETAHUI: forwards F1, F2 at T1<T2 (synthetic, per expiry), r, ex-date t_d in (T1, T2]. DITANYAKAN: cash dividend D paid in (T1, T2]. RUMUS: no-arbitrage carry F2 = F1 e^{r(T2-T1)} - D e^{r(T2-t_d)} -> D = (F1 e^{r(T2-T1)} - F2) e^{-r(T2-t_d)}. JAWAB: 1) forwards per expiry. 2) carry F1 to T2. 3) difference, discount to t_d. 4) repeat for consecutive expiries. 5) write.

title: Futures vs synthetic forward basis
frame: DIKETAHUI: listed futures prices and option chain per expiry. DITANYAKAN: basis. RUMUS: F_syn = K + (C - P)/DF; basis = F_syn - F_fut. JAWAB: 1) F_syn per expiry. 2) match futures. 3) basis. 4) write.

title: Coin-margined IV using futures forward Black-76
frame: DIKETAHUI: coin premiums, futures price per expiry (underlying_price), K, T. DITANYAKAN: IV. RUMUS: card Core 9 + V3(b): C_usd = C_coin x F; invert black76_price with F, DF (DF=1 if the task says). JAWAB: 1) F per row. 2) USD premium. 3) Brent on Black-76. 4) write.
